title: chat-types: make Attachment create fields optional before 0.4 freeze
description: Breaking-change freeze blocker. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 §Attachment Link makes blobId, filename, contentType, size and sha256 OPTIONAL on a Message/set create when filenodeId is present (server fills them; v9py.16.6, L172-178). crate-jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs Attachment (L118-149) has them as required pub fields (blob_id: Id, filename: String, content_type: String, size: u64, sha256: String); its own doc admits 'this type still requires them'. Implementing v9py.16.6 after the freeze would need Option<> on pub fields of a published struct (breaking) or a parallel create-input type. Decide the shape (Option fields vs separate AttachmentCreate input type, stored Attachment keeps required fields) and land it before 0.4. Additive filenodeId resolution hook on ChatBackend (defaulted, like attachment_blob) can follow later.
close_reason: Landed in 3ab0aec7 feat(chat-types)!: AttachmentCreate input type (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
